claims.title: UK NCSC OT secure connectivity
claims.claim: UK NCSC advises segregated OT, DMZ mediation, secure protocols and no direct IT-to-OT connection for shared data.
claims.limitations: Security architecture must still be adapted and validated for each site.

claims.title: Principles for secure integration of AI into OT
